vision: Our vision is a sustainable, community-based, volunteer-led club where as many as possible participate in GAA, LGFA and club activities, for as long as possible.
values: Community Identity · Inclusiveness · Respect · Player Welfare · Teamwork · Volunteerism

pillars.title: Games
pillars.tagline: Providing the best possible games experience for players and spectators

objectives.title: Developing the games
objectives.text: Make Gaelic football as enjoyable as possible so that players stay playing and spectators enjoy watching games — growing qualified coaches, re-establishing the Go Games ethos of fair game time for every child, and building a 'play and stay' culture from U12 to U23.

objectives.title: Providing games
objectives.text: Ensure players have an adequate number of meaningful games and an appropriate game-to-training ratio, with additional teams established at all ages and grades so every player gets playing opportunities regardless of ability.

objectives.title: Investment
objectives.text: Invest additional resources to safeguard the growth of St Kevin's, its teams and its membership, with a data-driven approach to tracking participation.

objectives.title: Collaborating with schools
objectives.text: Foster and consolidate our relationship with local primary and second-level schools to build player pathways, manage player workload, and optimise the pipeline of talent available to the club.

pillars.title: People
pillars.tagline: Unrivalled role support and personal development for players, coaches and volunteers

objectives.title: Growing players
objectives.text: Enable players to reach their potential through high-quality coaching, player supports and games opportunities — aligned to the Gaelic Games Player Pathway, with player profiling and styles of play to suit our players.

objectives.title: Sustaining volunteerism
objectives.text: Reduce the administrative burden on volunteers, streamline tasks, provide training, and build a pipeline of future role holders — with more opportunities for young people to volunteer and lead.

objectives.title: Continuous development
objectives.text: Engage with all centrally available GAA learning resources for quality learning experiences for coaches, officers, players and volunteers, including TY and Gaisce placements in club activity.

pillars.title: Club & Community
pillars.tagline: Supporting club and community survival and growth

objectives.title: Championing diversity and inclusion
objectives.text: Foster an inclusive culture — expanding the Allstars initiative to other club teams and positioning St Kevin's as the national standard for the GAA for All model.

objectives.title: Community partnerships
objectives.text: Formalise engagement with other community groups on health and wellbeing, physical activity and social inclusion — working towards Healthy Club and Green Club status.

objectives.title: Growing the GAA locally
objectives.text: Grow Gaelic games locally through our close community connection, sharing players, members and interests with Coill Dubh Hurling and Camogie clubs.

pillars.title: Communication
pillars.tagline: Striving for a more connected club

objectives.title: Proactive communications
objectives.text: Develop a proactive communications culture — up-to-date information in live time, an online club calendar reflecting all sporting and social activity, and telling the St Kevin's story in a contemporary way.

objectives.title: Connecting with members
objectives.text: A greater connection with current and past members — a member welcome pack, better access to club notes, a redesigned website, and reconnecting with past 'first club' members worldwide.

objectives.title: Engaging young people
objectives.text: Give young people opportunities to develop as leaders and have their voices heard — through Future Leaders, the Dermot Earley Youth Leadership initiative and club leadership programmes.

objectives.title: Irish language & culture
objectives.text: Celebrate Irish language and cultural activities through structures like Scór na nÓg, and partner with local performance arts groups.

objectives.title: One Club
objectives.text: Maximise our One Club structure across all codes — Gaelic football, LGFA, and ongoing support for hurling and camogie in the community — with fair facilities allocation and coordinated fundraising.

objectives.title: Safeguarding people
objectives.text: Strengthen policy compliance and risk management to safeguard the club, community and all members, particularly children — with full statutory compliance and biennial safeguarding risk assessments.

objectives.title: Investing in digital & data
objectives.text: An innovative digital strategy for communications, social media, data analytics and cloud technology — tracking participation and supporting the member growth strategy.

pillars.title: Resources
pillars.tagline: Ensuring the sustainability of St Kevin's finances and facilities

objectives.title: Re-balancing club resourcing
objectives.text: Refocus finance and fundraising on the growth of teams and membership — appointing a Registrar, reviewing membership types, and moving all membership activity to Foireann.

objectives.title: Financial sustainability
objectives.text: Standardised financial systems across the Club and Bar, ring-fenced team budgets, grant applications, and growing commercial income through sponsorship and business partnerships.

objectives.title: Safe and sustainable facilities
objectives.text: Develop and manage club facilities sustainably, exploring shared resourcing with other sporting and community groups, with a maintenance working group overseeing upkeep.

objectives.title: Environmental sustainability
objectives.text: Implement the Green Clubs Programme and equip members to operate in an environmentally sustainable way, mitigating the effects of climate change on the club and community.
